description: Ablation to measure the contribution of the href-rewriting step in XBRL package reconstruction. Disabling local href rewriting causes schemaRef/linkbaseRef attributes to retain original remote/company-specific URLs, testing whether FinMR queries contain self-contained XBRL artifacts.
key_finding: href rewriting is absolutely critical: without it, 0% of instances are executable. All 332 instances fail because the instance document's schemaRef points to original company-specific filenames (e.g. 'company-20230101.xsd') which do not match the local reconstructed 'schema.xsd'. Additionally, schema documents lack linkbaseRef entries pointing to local linkbase files. This confirms that FinMR queries do NOT contain self-contained XBRL artifacts -- the reconstruction pipeline's href rewriting step is indispensable.
